title: FootCap Shared Definitions
description: Reusable $defs shared across FootCap contract schemas: identifier, hash, UTC timestamp, and the closed V1 enums (temporal classification, evaluation context, prediction horizon, publication state, run status). This file has no standalone object shape of its own; it exists only to be referenced via $ref from the domain contract schemas in this directory. Governed by ADR-009 (docs/decisions/ADR-009-contracts-foundation.md); does not modify FOOTCAP_ARCHITECTURE_V1.2.1.md.

Identifier.description: Opaque, stable, immutable identifier. No specific encoding (UUID, ULID, etc.) is assumed by the shared contract; the concrete storage/database type is a separate implementation decision.

Hash.description: Opaque content hash string. The hashing algorithm is not fixed by this contract (open question tracked from the Phase 0.3.1 Contracts Foundation review).

UtcTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 timezone-aware UTC instant, e.g. 2026-08-10T15:30:00Z. Only the 'Z' (UTC) offset is accepted; numeric offsets and timezone-naive timestamps are rejected to keep a single canonical representation (Architecture Baseline section 5.2; ADR-009 decision 6).

TemporalClassification.description: Closed V1 temporal integrity classification (Architecture Baseline section 5.5). No PENDING/UNKNOWN/UNCLASSIFIED value exists; a persisted record always declares exactly one of these two values (ADR-009 decision 13).

EvaluationContext.description: Closed V1 run/prediction context (Architecture Baseline section 7.7). BACKTEST and EXPERIMENT must never be represented as PRODUCTION.

PredictionHorizon.description: V1 defines exactly one canonical prediction horizon (Architecture Baseline section 7.7). The enum is closed for V1; it is not silently open-ended.

PublicationState.description: Frozen V1 prediction publication lifecycle states (Architecture Baseline section 7.8). Valid transitions (DRAFT to PUBLISHED, PUBLISHED to SUPERSEDED, PUBLISHED to WITHDRAWN, and no other) are domain/application logic, not expressed by this enum.

RunStatus.description: Closed V1 execution status vocabulary shared by Job Run provenance and Prediction Run (Architecture Baseline sections 13.2 and 7.7).
